game.name: ProjectKagemaru (Virtua Fighter)
game.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 static recompilation runtime for Sega Model 1 Virtua Fighter (1993), tuned for Allwinner H700 / Anbernic RG34XX with on-device SLJIT ARM64 compilation, 3:2 widescreen, 60fps smooth motion, and Core 2 MultiPCM sound. Bring your own MAME vf.zip.
game.developer: SEGA AM2 (Recomp: mr-finster, ARM64 Port: ProjectKagemaru)
